summary: Global search results now actually open what they name, and the backup/restore progress tables no longer strand the percentage on its own line.
highlights: Options cards added by an app are now found by global search, in the user's own language.
System Settings results in global search open their step modal instead of doing nothing when clicked.
Options results reveal their card in the tabbed layout, and repeat selections from the Options page work.
Options cards the configuration does not render (a Language card on a single-language install) no longer appear as search results.
Progress percentage and its status message stay on one line in the backup and restore tables, whatever the message length.
